meta.title: seedmint: realistic sample data from any schema
meta.description: Paste a Prisma, Drizzle, Zod, SQL or JSON Schema and get realistic, localized sample data as SQL, seed.ts, JSON, CSV or an AI prompt. Free and open source.
meta.keywords: sample data generator, seed data, Prisma seed, Drizzle seed, Zod mock data, SQL INSERT generator, faker, test data, localized mock data

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Paste a schema, pick a language and format, get data you can use.
studio.inputHint: Prisma, Drizzle, Zod, TypeScript, SQL, DBML, GraphQL, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, CSV or a one-liner like users(name, email).
studio.newProjectConfirm: Clear the current schema and data to start a new project? Saved projects stay in History.
studio.edgeCasesHint: Empty, very long, emoji, quotes and RTL strings.
studio.builtFrom: Runs the same engine as the CLI: @seedmint/core.
studio.imported: {count} files read as {format}. {skipped} other files ignored.
studio.tablesHint: Rows to generate per table. Use 0 to leave a table empty.
studio.includeDdlHint: Adds tables and foreign keys before the INSERTs.
studio.regionalHint: Dates and numbers in the preview, CSV and Excel. SQL and code stay plain so they import cleanly.
studio.binaryNote: Binary file. Use Download to save it.
studio.refMissing: No matching row in the preview.
studio.autoRunHint: Rebuild the data when the schema or a setting changes
studio.linkTooLong: Schema is too long for a link. Export a file instead.
studio.storageFull: The browser could not save your latest changes (storage is full or blocked). Export what you need now, or a reload will lose it.

localesPage.title: Locales
localesPage.subtitle: Names, addresses and phones follow local rules. Mix locales in one table to test i18n.

formatsPage.title: Output formats
formatsPage.subtitle: One schema in, whatever your project needs out.

items.json: A JSON object keyed by table name.
items.jsonl: One JSON row per line, easy to stream or import.
items.csv: One CSV file per table for spreadsheets and bulk imports.
items.ts: Typed mock.ts with an interface per table.
items.prisma: seed.ts that calls prisma.createMany, ready to run.
items.drizzle: seed.ts that inserts through Drizzle ORM.
items.prompt: A Markdown prompt to paste into Cursor or Claude Code.

diagramPage.title: Diagram
diagramPage.subtitle: See your schema as an entity-relationship diagram.
diagramPage.hint: Paste a schema to draw it.
diagramPage.empty: No tables found in this schema.

legend.hint: Click a table to highlight what it links to

diagramPage.allHidden: Every table is hidden. Tick some in the list.
diagramPage.openHint: Double-click a table to open it in Studio
diagramPage.shortcuts: Shortcuts: F fit, 0 reset to 100%, + / - zoom

historyPage.title: History
historyPage.subtitle: Your databases and their versions, kept in this browser. Open one in Studio or the data admin, or export it again.
historyPage.empty: Nothing yet. Generate, export or save data and it appears here under its database.

construction.name: Construction (Vietnamese)

social.name: Social network

errors.schemaTooLarge: Schema is too large (3 MB max).
errors.folderTooLarge: The folder is too large to import.
errors.detectFailed: Could not detect the input format. Choose one under “Input format”.
errors.noSchemaFiles: No schema files found in this selection.

dataPage.title: Data
dataPage.subtitle: Browse and edit the rows of every table, built from your schema.
dataPage.empty: No data yet. Generate it from your schema, then add, edit and delete rows.
dataPage.regenerateConfirm: Replace all rows, including your edits, with newly generated data?
dataPage.formHint: Links to other tables are picked from existing rows.
dataPage.blocked: Can't delete: rows in {list} still point to this row.
dataPage.tooLarge: Too many rows to edit here. Lower the rows per table (up to {max}) in Studio.
dataPage.stale: The schema changed since this data was made. Regenerate to match it.

gate.title: Start a project
gate.subtitle: Every project has its own id and keeps its own schema, settings, edits and data, so projects never mix.
gate.blankHint: Start empty and paste or import your own schema.
gate.samplesHint: A sample is copied into a new project; the original sample is never changed.
